id: title:charlesvien:standardize on gravatar avatars for people

review.posthog_relevance: Replaces account-specific avatar and account settings with a shared UserAvatar component and UserLike interface, supporting reuse across desktop and shared packages.
review.reason: Adds a shared UserLike interface and replaces account-specific avatar implementation with a shared UserAvatar component, removing account-specific account settings and initials. This supports reuse across packages and reduces account-specific duplication.
review.uncertainty: The chunk explicitly notes P1.F14 and P1.F15 are unrelated, but P1.F15 and P1.F16 appear cohesive. P1.F14 is excluded. The tier is conservative because the benefit is localized to avatar and account settings, not broader system capability. No tier assignment requested.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds explicit export to UserLike interface, shared across desktop and shared packages.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, exported type for avatar-related user properties, supporting reuse across packages.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not provide a complete, reviewable change group. P1.F14 and P1.F15 hunks are clearly unrelated: P1.F14 changes an avatar implementation in the MCP Gateway, while P1.F15 and P1.F16 remove an AccountSettings component and its dependencies. No shared context or dependency relationship is established, and the chunk does not indicate whether P1.F16 is a removal of a file
